verdict.rationale: Porkbun exposes full DNS record CRUD (A/CNAME/etc.) and a guided Cloudflare hand-off flow, plus its own static/WordPress hosting provisioning, which lets a founder wire up a site manually or via API/MCP. But there's no evidence of guided one-click templates or presets for connecting to major third-party hosts/platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Shopify, Squarespace, Google Workspace, etc.) — the founder would need to manually configure DNS records rather than pick a host from a guided list. Missing for 10: one-click/preset connect flows for named major hosting platforms, a UI wizard beyond raw DNS record editing, and independent confirmation of any such guided templates.
